title: TZSP: Add support for 6GHz band
description:
To support WiFi-6E (IEEE 802.11ax) devices operating in 6GHz band, 59
new channels in the 6GHz band are added to the existing TZSP channel
list.

notes.body:
do you have verified your account ?

no break change for field size ?

Hi Alexis, 
Can you please suggest how to get my account verified ?

On increasing the 'Channel' field size from 1 byte to 2 bytes, I have tested by capturing the packets in 2.4GHz, 5GHz and 6GHz bands. All tests have passed.
but for some old capture ?

With 'Channel' field increased to 2 bytes, older captures where 'Channel' field is considered as 1 byte will be decoded as 'Unknown'. ![OlderCapture](/uploads/33cdc9acc4b304b7c5db3bac9413cafe/OlderCapture.PNG)
Ok, it is a TLV value, may be use length for channel ?
Sure. Will use length for channel and make changes accordingly.
for mail, can you look https://gitlab.com/-/profile/emails ?
msrinivas@extremenetworks.com is verified and used as Primary, commit and notification email.
@geraldcombs any idea with it is not yet good ?
rebase the change and it is work... :-/

there is always 2 commits

'length' variable changes are done with separate commit instead of amending to the first commit. So, got 2 commits. 
Is it fine having 2 commits or should I need to have 1 commit ?
Will squash resolve this issue?

Merge button is disabled due to pipeline failure. 
I have now enabled squash but even then squash option is not available.
